scope: Active first-response Spot net inventory with original gross intent preservation; not full native cash accounting or terminal recovery application.

reproduction.method: Execute the baseline _apply_open_order AST from Git HEAD with current unchanged acknowledgement helpers and a synthetic complete BUY receipt.

implementation.new_spot_open: Only exact FILLED original gross quantity plus complete native commissions can release the opening intent. Active qty is net base received. Partial or missing native evidence leaves UNKNOWN without applying a guessed lot.
implementation.legacy: Empty receipt fields are omitted from canonical request templates to preserve old opening and nested closing request bytes. Legacy lots receive no invented commission history.
implementation.close: Retain original receipt metadata, submit remaining net quantity, validate eight-decimal float-wire representability, and subtract native quantities with a private 128-digit Decimal context. Do not drop a nonzero native remainder under the old float tolerance.
implementation.modeled_fees: Entry fee estimate remains based on gross traded notional. Quote/BNB valuation and full native PnL are not implemented.

stages.suite: two additional native interruption and close-wire cases
native opening observation, execution scope, position mutation and reconciliation

Final whitespace-only edits were checked for AST equivalence.
